narr: Showers and storms accompanied a slow-moving cold front during the afternoon and evening of the 9th. A period of more persistent rain fell across southeast Bell County during the evening hours and led to a few instances of nuisance flash flooding in the Clear Fork basin of southeast Bell County.
ev: Bell County dispatch and the public reported water blocking KY-188 near the Colmar community.
Bell County dispatch reported flood waters blocking KY-217 near Pine Branch Road. Social media reports also indicated flooding just upstream in the Hutch community.
